name: Challenge: A stale tab refuses overwrite and saves a separate conflict copy
description: Exercise the compiled local PixiBun build through user controls. Use a desktop viewport. Compare actual artwork and persistent state, not only element visibility. Missing prerequisites or unobservable cancellation must be reported rather than silently skipped.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /studio.
Verify restoration has finished and the main drawing canvas is editable.
Rename the project to Challenge stale original using the project-name control and confirm with Enter.
Select the Pen tool.
Draw a short horizontal stroke in the upper-left quarter of the drawing canvas, away from its borders.
Click Save drawing.
Verify the save status says Changes saved.
Open /studio in a second browser tab in the SAME browser storage session; keep the first tab open.
Verify the second tab restores Challenge stale original with the same horizontal stroke.
Return to the first tab.
Draw a separate short vertical stroke in the lower-right quarter of the drawing canvas.
Click Save drawing.
Verify the save status says Changes saved.
Return to the second tab without reloading it.
Draw a diagonal stroke in the upper-right quarter of the canvas.
Click Save drawing.
Verify an alert reports the project changed in another tab and offers Save a copy; a success save message alone is insufficient.
Click Save a copy in the second tab.
Verify the conflict alert disappears.
Reload the second tab.
Verify its independent copy contains the horizontal and diagonal strokes, with no lower-right vertical stroke.
Open File, then Projects.
Open project Challenge stale original.
Verify the original contains the horizontal and vertical strokes, with no diagonal stroke from the stale tab.
